import sys

MOD = 10**9 + 7

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.readline
    n, T = map(int, input().split())
    t = [0] * n
    g = [0] * n
    for i in range(n):
        ti, gi = map(int, input().split())
        t[i] = ti
        g[i] = gi

    max_mask = 1 << n

    # Sum of durations for every subset
    sum_time = [0] * max_mask
    for mask in range(1, max_mask):
        lsb = mask & -mask
        i = lsb.bit_length() - 1
        sum_time[mask] = sum_time[mask ^ lsb] + t[i]

    # dp[mask][last] = number of valid playlists using exactly songs in mask
    # and ending with song 'last'
    dp = [[0] * n for _ in range(max_mask)]

    for i in range(n):
        if t[i] <= T:
            dp[1 << i][i] = 1

    ans = 0

    for mask in range(1, max_mask):
        total = sum_time[mask]
        if total > T:
            continue

        if total == T:
            ans = (ans + sum(dp[mask])) % MOD
            continue

        for last in range(n):
            cur = dp[mask][last]
            if cur == 0:
                continue
            glast = g[last]
            rem = (~mask) & (max_mask - 1)
            while rem:
                lsb = rem & -rem
                nxt = lsb.bit_length() - 1
                if g[nxt] != glast and total + t[nxt] <= T:
                    dp[mask | lsb][nxt] = (dp[mask | lsb][nxt] + cur) % MOD
                rem ^= lsb

    print(ans % MOD)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
